findings.description: Route handler runs a Drizzle query against webhookDeliveries directly instead of delegating to the service/repository.
Service reads the webhook secret via process.env.GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET instead of container.secrets.get(...).
Route hand-builds a 401 error envelope with reply.status().send({ error: ... }) instead of throwing a typed domain error.
enrichWithAuthor lives in helpers.ts but awaits a Drizzle db.select() call — I/O inside what should be a pure helper.
saveSummary decides whether to update vs insert and conditionally enqueues a notification job (container.jobs.enqueue at line 31) — orchestration/business decisions living in the repository.
generate() takes a Fastify FastifyReply and calls reply.status(...) directly — HTTP status mapping belongs in routes.ts, not the service.
Imports and instantiates RepoRepository from the repos module directly (line 14) instead of reaching repo data through the container's shared capability.
Constructs `new OctokitGitHubClient(token)` directly instead of pulling the GitHub adapter off the container (e.g. container.github()).
list() (and the upsertMember existing-row lookup at line 21) query teamMembers with no workspaceId filter — not tenancy-scoped.

grading.match_rule: A finding counts as matched if the review output identifies the same file AND the same underlying issue (by rule), independent of exact wording or whether it cites the line number.
